contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman copper alloy Nummus, House of Constantine (AD 306-364). VRBS ROMA commemorative, the mint mark is unclear; probably Trier, (AD 330-335). Reece period 17 (AD 330-348). Obverse: Helmeted bust of Roma left. Legend: VRBS ROMA. Reverse: Wolf suckling twins, two stars above. Legend: M.-m.: -/-//[]. Mint mark: Probably Trier: TRS/TRP.
